title: Chapter 1057
text:
As soon as this was said, the expressions of the Beyond Grade As present changed. They remained silent and did not reply. They were all analyzing the situation quickly and felt that the current situation was very troublesome.

The reason they attacked the frontline stronghold was to get rid of Hella while Black Star's main body was not around. They did not want to fight Black Star's main body head-on.

Black Star had the strength of a peak Beyond Grade A, and his Indestructible Body was extremely difficult to deal with. Plus, his identity was special, and he had the Evolution Cube, which was of great importance to the dynasty. Since his main body was here, he would definitely bring a Universal Treasure like the Spacetime Amber, which would be extremely difficult to deal with.

Killing Hella in front of Black Star's main body would be many times more difficult.

"I'm afraid we won't have a chance. I didn't expect him to come with his main body." Sagman stared at Han Xiao in the sky with fear.

If it were any other Beyond Grade A Mechanic, it would be a risk for them to come with their main body. However, Black Star had already proven that he was a clear stream among the fragile Mechanics.

All of a sudden, everyone hesitated and looked at each other, unable to make up their minds.

At the same time, Sierron finally stabilized his body. His face was filled with anger and shock. He held his broken arm and stared at Han Xiao.

I'm a peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist, but I couldn't even block the charge of a Mechanic and was heavily injured in one move?

Sierron was shocked when he thought of the power of that attack.

Even in his opinion, it was extremely rare to see such powerful single-target lethality.

At this moment, Sierron was shocked. There was only one thought in his mind.

What kind of palm technique did Black Star use?

"He actually has such a trump card …"

Sierron's fear of Han Xiao increased by a few levels.

He turned his head to look at his severed arm and controlled his muscles and blood vessels to contract, stopping the bleeding instantly. Then, he used his pugilist energy to catalyze the proliferation of cells. A new arm grew out from the severed arm. Compared to the other parts of the arm, the skin was obviously much more tender.

Sierron casually smashed the severed arm floating in space into atoms, leaving no trace behind. Then, he slowly flew back to the battlefield. Suppressing the shock and anger in his heart, he did not attack immediately. Instead, he observed everyone's expressions and pondered.

Kasuyi quietly floated to the side, looking at Han Xiao without any intention of speaking.

The field fell into a strange silence. Han Xiao, Sierron, and Kasuyi, the three peak Beyond Grade As, stood facing each other, while the rest of the Beyond Grade As looked at the three of them.

Everyone knew in their hearts that whether they would fight or negotiate would depend on the negotiation of the three big shots.

Black Star's main body entered the arena and said some harsh words, then did not do anything for the time being. The Beyond Grade As were not surprised by this. After all, there were so many of them. Even if Black Star arrived, he would not dare to act recklessly.

He's alone and probably unwilling to have a direct confrontation with more than ten Beyond Grade As on both sides. Thus, he has no choice but to suppress his anger and resolve the problem through negotiation.

Understanding this, the expressions of the Beyond Grade As present became much more relaxed.

Since Black Star's main body was here, they should indeed retreat. However, this was not because they were afraid of Black Star but because the mission success rate had plummeted. There was no need to continue fighting here.

Although they were afraid of Black Star's main body's strength and Universal Treasure, with so many Beyond Grade As here, there was no need to be afraid of Black Star. In the eyes of Sagman and the others, Black Star was just one person. He could protect himself, but he would not be able to do anything.

While everyone was guessing, Han Xiao silently waited for the Mech Legion behind to catch up to him while looking at the interface.

Emergency Mission: [Rescue Hella]

Mission Introduction: Hella's Esper Ability has caused the fear of many Beyond Grade As. Her powerful talent has brought about a calamity of fate. Ethereal and Radiance have decided to take action to eliminate this hidden danger.

Mission Requirements: Hella survives the attack.

Reward: 750,000,000 – 920,000,000 Experience, + 1 Legendary Point, x4 Random Reward, x4 Unknown Character Summon Cards, x1 Blank Character Summon Card.

Additional Mission Requirements: Cooperate with the dynasty's reinforcements to capture the invading Beyond Grade A Supers.

Additional Reward: Every time you capture a Beyond Grade A Supers, you will be able to draw one ability from them.

"This is probably the most difficult mission so far …" Han Xiao was speechless.

The number of Beyond Grade As present was similar to the Battle of Planet Lighthouse, but Han Xiao did not have any reinforcements by his side. He only had Hella, but he had to face more than ten Beyond Grade As. The last person who faced a similar situation was EsGod, and his outcome was to obtain five hundred years of rights to a luxurious single cell in the dynasty.

However, the mission reward was also unprecedentedly generous. As long as he captured a Beyond Grade A Supers, he would be able to draw one ability from them. The more he captured, the more chances he would be able to draw.

"My main body is here. The chances of Ethereal and Radiance killing Hella in front of me are not high, so I'll probably have to retreat immediately. I don't know when the dynasty's reinforcements will arrive, so I'll have to rely on myself to complete the mission …"

Han Xiao had already made up his mind on the way there, so he did not waver.

He calmed down a little and thought of something else.

On the way, he had received a report from Black Star Palace saying that a Beyond Grade A had come to challenge him, and Ames had already accepted the challenge. Everything was strange.

Han Technician had always maintained contact with the main camp, so he knew about the current situation. That Traveler had displayed his true strength and was stirring up trouble. Furthermore, the Lord's Avatar shared the strength of the main body, so only one could exist at a time. If Han Xiao was distracted by the main camp, his main body would be in trouble.

"Interesting, purposely drawing my attention to make it easier for Ethereal and Radiance … Hmm, Traveler."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

Traveler was a neutral Beyond Grade A on the surface, but he actually had a close relationship with a Supercluster civilization. Very few people knew about this.

However, to him, Traveler's identity was not a secret. It had been exposed long ago in his previous life.

Could it be that Ethereal and Radiance were working together with a Supercluster civilization on this matter?

"No, it's not them." Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he rejected this guess.

Traveler's identity was a secret in the outside world. Even if Radiance and Ethereal were working together with a Supercluster civilization, the Supercluster civilization would not send Traveler. Otherwise, Traveler's identity would be exposed.

"Looks like there's more to this …"

Han Xiao frowned slightly.

He did not care too much about the truth. Anyway, he only knew one thing, which was that the Super Star Cluster civilization behind Traveler definitely had something to do with it.

Others might not know Traveler's origin, but he knew it clearly. There was no need for him to investigate at all. He could just put the blame on the civilization behind Traveler, and it would be simple and easy.

"You dare to cause trouble in my home? You sure have guts. The Throne is still on the way. When we reach the main camp, I'll deal with you," Han Xiao thought to himself.

This time, Hella flew to Han Xiao's side.

The other Beyond Grade As did not stop her but followed silently to the side of their respective captains, confronting Han Xiao and the Mech Legion behind him.

"Actually … you shouldn't have come." Hella's expression was complicated.

The way she saw it, in order to save her, Han Xiao's main body had rushed here, which was equivalent to walking into this trap and being surrounded by more than ten Beyond Grade As.

Hella knew that compared to her, Black Star was the real thorn in the side of Ethereal and Radiance. He even had Universal Treasures like the Evolution Cube and the Spacetime Amber on him. If these enemies changed their plans at the last minute and took this opportunity to target Black Star … she would have harmed him.

Originally, Hella thought that she was definitely going to die and wanted to see Han Xiao one last time. However, when he really came, Hella could not help but worry about Han Xiao's safety.

All along, Hella's life motto had been to press forward. She rarely wavered and worried about her gains and losses.

"If I didn't come, who would have saved you?" Han Xiao turned around and gave her a gentle smile. "You're already safe. If you want to ask why, it's because I'm here."

Hella bit her lips lightly and suddenly took the initiative to hold Han Xiao's hand.

Han Xiao raised his brows and was about to say something when he suddenly felt a wave of life energy coming from Hella's hand. A bunch of buffs popped up on the interface.

"Aurora's ability can now increase the combat power of life forms. There's not much I can do, so I can only share my life energy with you," Hila said nonchalantly after a few seconds of clenching her fists, "Aurora's ability can now increase the combat power of life forms. I can't do much, so I can only share my life energy with you."

"… Thanks."

At this moment, Sierron spoke with a deep voice.

"Black Star, since your main body is here, I'll give you some face. I have a deal here. I wonder if you're interested."

He felt that Han Xiao was stalling for time and waiting for reinforcements, so he did not plan to continue the confrontation and started the conversation.

Hearing this, Han Xiao looked back at Sierron, stopped smiling, and said calmly, "Speak."

"How about we make a deal? As long as you agree to unseal the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter for Radiance, not only will we retreat, but we'll also help you deal with Ethereal." Sierron's eyes lingered on Kasuyi.

Han Xiao had used [Charge — Endless Potential] in that attack just now along with Yin Ying's Character Summon Card, [Comet Glide].

In fact, he had already arrived at the edge of the battlefield and had been accumulating power. Originally, he wanted to kill an ordinary Beyond Grade A, but he did not expect Sierron to take the initiative to intercept him. Han Xiao had no choice but to unleash the power he had been accumulating on this thick-skinned Beyond Grade A.

Although the lethality of this attack was far from enough to make a peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist lose his combat power, it was enough to make Sierron wary. Seeing that the plan was difficult to carry out, he gave up on the plan of taking hostages and turned around to achieve his goal through a deal.

At this time, Sierron did not know that Kasuyi was an actor. He felt that Black Star was alone and needed help.

Kasuyi did not care at all. "Then our Ethereal will definitely retreat immediately so that you won't be able to succeed. In the end, it'll still benefit Black Star."

As he spoke, Kasuyi suddenly blinked and said, "Since Radiance has an idea, I'll also propose a deal on behalf of Ethereal."

"Go ahead." Han Xiao looked at him and said calmly, "Go ahead."

"Black Star, I know that your Spacetime Amber is very magical and can imprison Beyond Grade As. How about this, you and I will work together to capture these Beyond Grade As of the Radiant Federation and sell them to Ethereal. Then, our Ethereal will have the chips to get the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter back. What do you think?"

Sierron's face darkened, and he coldly glared at Kasuyi.

Just as the two of them were arguing, Han Xiao took a deep breath and slowly said, "No need to bother.

I'll reject all of your deals … You came to beat up my people, and you want to make a deal with me? Don't even think about it! All of you Beyond Grade As, come at me together. "

Sierron's eyes widened, and he looked at Han Xiao in disbelief.

Kasuyi was also surprised. This was not in the script.

Not only the two of them, but the other ten Beyond Grade As of Radiance and Ethereal were all shocked and stared at Han Xiao in disbelief.

Is this guy … crazy?

One person fighting more than ten Beyond Grade As, two of which are peak Beyond Grade As, is this not courting death?

After the initial shock, the crowd was enraged.

You're looking down on us too much. Do you think we Beyond Grade As are all made of paper?

Black Star, you don't understand the situation, do you? So what if your main body is here? Do you really think you can fight all of us alone? We're retreating because we're afraid of you?

"Are you serious?" Sierron's face completely darkened.

"You destroyed my frontline stronghold, tried to assassinate my Deputy Army Commander, and now you want to retreat in front of me without me doing anything … Do you think that's possible?"

Boom!

Han Xiao's tone was firm, and his energy fluctuated higher and higher.

Hearing this, everyone's eyes became more and more unfriendly.

Sierron was even more furious. "You better think carefully! Looking at the current situation, we might as well go all the way and make you our target! "

Hearing this, Hella's expression tightened. She immediately stood in front of Han Xiao, and her death energy spread out again.

No matter what decision Han Xiao made, no matter how strong the enemy was, she would fight side by side with Han Xiao without any hesitation.

This time, Han Xiao held her shoulder, pressed her behind him, and slowly said, "Don't be so nervous.

"Don't be so nervous. I alone am enough."

The next moment, an earth-shattering energy fluctuation exploded from Han Xiao's body.

Sizzle!

The violent golden Mechanical Force was like lightning whips, flashing crazily. Han Xiao's energy fluctuation seemed to be soaring endlessly.

Facing more than ten Beyond Grade As, Han Xiao did not dare be careless and used his trump card without hesitation!

[Mecha Empire Summon Card — The Ancient One]!

[Tyrant Summon Card — Polar Channel Flow — Cellular Overdrive]!

[Dragon Emperor Summon Card — Force Field — Dragon Body]!

[Nero Summon Card — Perfect Mechanical Sense]!

The effects of multiple Character Summon Cards stacked together. At this moment, the energy fluctuation that Han Xiao was emitting was terrifying even to peak Beyond Grade As. It even stung the senses of everyone present.

The expressions of Sagman and the others changed drastically. The anger in their eyes turned into shock!

The power that Han Xiao was emitting right now far exceeded their understanding of Han Xiao's strength!

Even Kasuyi, who had been calm all this while, was shocked at this moment!

Han Xiao's eyes lit up like two little blue suns.

"Let me see how many of you can run away!"

Without waiting for the Beyond Grade As from Radiance and Ethereal to recover from their shock, Han Xiao's body trembled. Mechanical Force shot out and connected with the Mech Legion like a lightning spider web.

The next moment, the steel torrent formed by the Mech Legion poured down!
